title: Safehouse and Border
author: Odile Hartwell
blurb: Rafael Amberdale, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
